name: Stack
description: Vertical flow: adds space between consecutive children, which keep their own width. Bare inline children (links, spans) stack too. The default way to space components vertically.

values.name: sm
values.description: Tight spacing (0.5rem), e.g. form-field internals or list items.

values.name: lg
values.description: Loose spacing (2rem), e.g. between page blocks.

whenToUse: Anything that flows top to bottom: form fields, paragraphs, a card body, a page column.
Changing rhythm: nest a smaller stack (l-stack--sm) inside a larger one.
whenNotToUse: Items in a row that wrap: use `l-cluster`.
use: Nest stacks with different gaps to build rhythm.
avoid: Adding margins to children to fix spacing; change the stack modifier instead.

do.text: Let the stack own the space between its children.

dont.text: Don't fix spacing with margins on the children.
